name: Monitor Cages Track
implementation_notes: Full rewrite (v3) mirroring MonitorGradingView.vue/gradingRecordRepo.ts's screen-008 v4 pattern: 2-card 'Hari Ini' counter (Jumlah Cages Track / Jumlah Cage/Lori Tercatat) + scrollable draft/pause list (uniform 'Pause' label) + New Data/Load Data buttons + tappable breadcrumb + hamburger. Old single-summary/primary-action/Pause-Clear-on-Monitor UI removed entirely.

cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts screen-009 block added getTodaySummary(userId) (COUNT cages_track_record + SUM total_cages across their cages_tipped_time rows WHERE date(date)=today, any status — via 2 sequential queries with an empty-IN-list guard, since localDb.ts has no JOIN helper) and getDrafts(userId). createDraft() now also sets tippler_start_time=now at INSERT time, per entity-catalog v3's auto-fill-once rule. Pre-v3 screen-012/015 block (getDraftWithTippedTimes/saveDraft/etc.) left untouched, still targets pre-v3 columns — will be rewritten when screen-012 itself is implemented.

Environment fix during verification (not a code defect, RECURRING issue — second time this session): task #27's backend migration work ran `php artisan migrate:fresh` again, wiping the demo business_unit/user rows a second time. This time fixed PERMANENTLY rather than ad hoc: created backend/database/seeders/DemoAccountSeeder.php (idempotent via firstOrCreate, seeds corporate/company/business_unit + admin/supervisor01/operator01), registered in DatabaseSeeder.php, and updated mobile/tests/e2e/helpers.ts's header comment to point to it. Future migrate:fresh + db:seed (or db:seed --class=DemoAccountSeeder alone) will no longer lose e2e login capability.

Independently re-verified (not just agent self-report): 324/324 vitest across all 20 files, 8/8 Playwright (monitor-cages-track.spec.ts) after the seeder fix — agent's own run had reported 0/8 blocked by the environment issue before the fix.

known_issues.description: FormCagesTrackView.vue / DataPreviewCagesTrackView.vue (screen-012/015) and cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts's older block (getDraftWithTippedTimes/saveDraft/pre-v3 types) still target pre-entity-catalog-v3 columns (cage_number/tipped_time) — will break if exercised as-is. Deliberately left untouched (out of scope for Monitor screen); must be rewritten as part of screen-012's own implementation.

Navigasi ke route names cages-track-form (screen-012) dan data-preview-cages-track (screen-015) tetap mengarah ke implementasi lama/pre-v3 sampai kedua screen tersebut direvisi — sequencing yang diharapkan.
Unit test coverage % — 99.02%, jauh di atas threshold 80%.
